quotes.text: I was a little skeptical of this tour when I saw how many boats there were. I’ve gone on great airboat tours with smaller companies before. But I was pleasantly surprised! We had 10 people and a local guide who had extensive knowledge of the ecology of the bayou. We saw plenty of gators and he got very excited when we started asking specific questions about the gators and the environment. He enjoys his job and loves to teach people everything about the area. He was very entertaining. Worth every penny!

What an amazing tour—perfect for families with young kids. Our guide was friendly and incredibly knowledgeable about the area. The kids loved spotting blue herons, alligators, turtles, cows, and other wildlife. We had such a great time and highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to explore the swamps near New Orleans.

This is a "MUST" when you visit New Orleans. Our tour guide was funny and informative about the marsh and alligators. My husband and I had a blast, the staff is friendly and there is FREE parking. We did the small boat ride, the guide was attentive to everyone and made sure the ride was a memorable experience.

Our tour guide Larry was great and found many different alligators, birds and even a bald eagle for us to see. He was knowledgeable and nice and we had an amazing time!! Definitely recommend this tour.
Awesome tour. Our guide, Ronnie, was hilarious! He really made our group tour memorable. I’m he was funny, authentic and very informative.
Outstanding experience! Captain Jay was fun and informative. We learned a bit of history and found gators up close.
